slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation, the author's own analysis) states that rural primary schools in Chad record administrative data, annual attendance snapshots and repetition and pass rates on handwritten paper questionnaires and registers, with no digital tool at the school, and scores them 1; it gives no date for the statement, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: School directors and teachers fill 4-10 page paper forms by hand; the forms are carried up through zone inspectors, district and province to the national DAPRO, where they are keyed into StatEduc2; last full surveys given as 2016 and 2019
Pilot in 2 provinces, not scaled; what it collects is not stated
Described as focused on content, not on recording at the school

note: An excluded source under study.json; the one fact is recorded as the document states it and is labelled as an AI-assisted compilation.
